'''Sigil''' was a Sister of the [[Sisterhood of the Glorious Radiance]]. She gave a guided tour of the [[Temple of the Glorious Radiance]] during [[Tash Arranda/Legends|Tash Arranda's]] visit to [[Lorrd/Legends|Lorrd]] in [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]].
